title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a save naming no package at a bundle member only the dependent holds writes the row-held base's row the bare read addresses
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x8Be2AAcUBhodBsvnWLd3Xs)_

Fixes #35524

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 用户能看到什么变化：同一封邮件模板，基座包存了英文版、依赖它的包只存了法文版时，不指定包去保存法文版（直接保存或存草稿），以前改的是依赖包那一份、随后按名字读法文版仍显示“找不到”；现在写进基座包的法文版，与指定基座包保存完全一样，依赖包那一份原样保留，保存后按名字一读就能看到刚存的内容；不指定包的读草稿、发布草稿、丢弃草稿也一并对准基座包那份草稿。
2. 为什么做：落实「同一个地址，读到谁就写谁」这条已定规则，补上“基座包和依赖包同名邮件模板”这一类里尚未覆盖的一格。
3. 出错会怎样：只影响基座包和依赖包都存了同一邮件模板、且某语言只有依赖包有的环境；只有依赖包草稿时，不指定包发布会被拒并提示指定依赖包，丢弃则不动并说明草稿还在；可直接撤回本次改动，不需要迁移数据。
4. 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

At a named non-canonical member of a bundled type's name no package ships (today `email_template`, e.g. `fr-FR`), where an authored base package holds the canonical member as a stored row and only a package declaring that base holds a row of the member, the read naming no package takes the base's address (`rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, the S1-guarded arm; unchanged, pinned in `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` M1, M2, S2) and answers 404. The doors naming no package that write or address that member's draft now resolve the same address:

- `packagelessRowHeldBaseAddress` (`protocol-save.ts`) also answers the base where the member's active rows are bound to exactly one package, that package is not the base, and the read's own judgment names the base (`rowHeldBaseAddressOf`, asked, not copied). Two or more holders answer exactly as before (#34681).
- The publish-mode save naming no package asks it in its one-holder branch (after the holder refusal, so every refusal stands) and writes as the save naming the base does.
- The draft doors' address naming no package (`packagelessDraftAddress`, behind the draft save, the strict draft read, the per-item publish and the draft discard) is wrapped by the new `packagelessRowHeldBaseDraftAddress`: at this cell it answers the base's draft, promoted into the base's row. The draft save sets the base as its package (the repository otherwise resolves its own write head), as the #34681 follow arm does, so the named-base rule and the late override re-judgment judge the base.

Ruling route: the write follows the read (epic ruling 6781691009, 「a write resolves its address exactly as the read at the same address resolves it」; #34348 ruling (b), 「reads and writes give the same answer」). The read is not changed.

FROM to TO (BREAKING, the narrowing arm):
- bare save (REST `PUT`, in process), `active`: the dependent's row silently updated, read after it 404 (or 409) → the base's row written at the member, as `?package=BASE` writes it; the dependent's row byte-unchanged; read after it 200 at the base.
- bare draft save: the dependent's draft → the base's draft, as `?package=BASE`.
- bare draft read / per-item publish / draft discard: the dependent's draft read, promoted, removed → the base's draft read, promoted, removed. With only the dependent's draft stored: publish 200 into the dependent's row → `404 NO_DRAFT` naming that draft; discard removed it → `200` receipt that discards nothing and names the remaining draft. Both equal the same request naming the base.

Files: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` (the helper's one-holder arm, the publish-mode and draft-mode save address, the new draft-address wrapper), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (the facade's `packagelessDraftAddress` forwards through the wrapper; still one forwarding call, `check:facade-delegation-only` green). Pins: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-bare-save-dependent-only-member-35524.test.ts` (new, named for this card, the #34681 fixture shape). Changeset: `.changeset/35524-bare-save-follows-base-dependent-member.md` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch, both declaration lines, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

No spec touch: the save request's `packageId` description's row-held-base exception sentence stays true (it covers a member the base and the dependent both hold). Its earlier sentence, "an `active` save then writes the row of the one package the item's active rows are bound to", now has this cell as a second exception; that text is left to sibling card #35529 (see Acceptance notes).

Declarations: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` because a published accept set narrows (the bare publish of the dependent's lone draft at this member moves from 200 to 404 `NO_DRAFT`) and what a bare write lands in moves (the dependent's row → the base's row), the epic ruling's "D's row silently updated → E's row (narrowing)" shape. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no key, accepted value or meaning of authored metadata moves; what moves is the row a request naming no package addresses, as PR #35450 declared for the sibling move.

Read first (by risk):
1. `protocol-save.ts`, `packagelessRowHeldBaseAddress`: the new equality `address.candidates.includes(base) === address.candidates.length > 1` (two or more: the base among them; one: the base is not that one).
2. `protocol-save.ts`, `packagelessRowHeldBaseDraftAddress` and the draft save's widened follow condition (`draftAddress.into !== null`).
3. `protocol.ts`, the facade's `packagelessDraftAddress`, now the one resolution every bare draft door shares.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-bare-save-dependent-only-member-35524.test.ts` after building `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`; expect `Tests 6 passed (6)`.

## Tests

<details><summary>The card's 3-step sequence, measured on main a73edb3cd7 and on this head (booted kernel, real protocol and sqlite store)</summary>

Fixture: authored WA holds `en-US`, authored WD (declares WA) holds `fr-FR`, same `email_template` name.

| Step | main, rows stored after boot | main, kernel booted over the rows | this head (both) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1. `GET ?member=fr-FR` | 404 | 404 | 404 |
| 2. `PUT` fr-FR, no package | 200, rewrites WD's row | 200, rewrites WD's row | 200, writes a new WA row at fr-FR |
| rows after (package_id, bundle_member) | WA/canonical, WD/fr-FR (edited) | same | WA/canonical, WD/fr-FR (unchanged), WA/fr-FR (edited) |
| 3. `GET ?member=fr-FR` | 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT | 404 | 200 at WA, the saved content |

Why step 3 answered 409 on main: only where the rows were stored after boot. The registry then held no row of WA's; the save's registry write-through registered WD's fr-FR item, so the registry named WD the name's one holder, and the read, at the base's address, was refused by the exact-qualifier judgment ("not held by package WA ... held by package WD"). `?package=WA&member=fr-FR` answered the same 409. On a kernel booted over the rows (registry hydrated with both), step 3 answered 404. Either way the save wrote a row the read did not serve.

The save naming WA at fr-FR on main (in process and REST `PUT ?package=WA`): 200, writes a new WA row at fr-FR, WD's row untouched, and the bare read then serves it (200 at WA). So the stop rule did not trigger; this head makes the bare save answer exactly that.

</details>

<details><summary>Per-door conclusions at the cell (main → this head)</summary>

- save, publish mode (REST and in process): moved, pinned (writes WA's row, as named).
- draft save: moved, pinned (writes WA's draft, as named).
- strict draft read: moved, pinned (WD's draft → WA's draft; the draft the bare draft save writes).
- per-item publish: moved, pinned (promotes WA's draft into WA's row; with only WD's draft, 404 `NO_DRAFT`, equal to `?package=WA`).
- draft discard: moved, pinned (removes WA's draft; with only WD's draft, a receipt that discards nothing, equal to `?package=WA`).
- delete: unchanged, out of scope (still removes WD's row; it asks the row-held base only with two or more holders). See Acceptance notes.
- history / diff / rollback: unchanged, out of scope (still WD's versions and row, through `historySlotOf`'s two-or-more guard). See Acceptance notes.
- After the first bare save writes WA's row at the member, the cell is the #34681 cell (two holders, the base among them) and every door follows the base as PR #35450 pinned.

</details>

<details><summary>Pins (new file) and controls</summary>

`meta-bare-save-dependent-only-member-35524.test.ts`, 6 tests:
1. REST `PUT` and in-process save on a kernel booted over the rows: step 1 404; WD's row byte-identical before and after (every stored column); rows equal to the save naming WA; no package-unbound row; bare read 200 at WA, `?package=WD` still WD's; and after a restart.
2. Rows stored after boot: the bare save writes WA's row and the bare read serves it (was 409).
3. Draft save: WA's draft, same rows as the named draft save, WD's row byte-identical; bare draft read serves it; bare publish promotes into WA's row; bare read 200; bare discard removes the draft the bare draft save wrote.
4. WD's own draft at the cell: bare publish and discard answer exactly what `?package=WA` answers; `?package=WD` publishes it.
5. Read-only (code) base holding rows: the bare save answers 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` naming the base, as `?package=BASE` (was the same code naming the dependent).
6. CONTROLS: the canonical member both hold (the #34681 cell) still writes the base's row; the canonical member only the dependent holds (S1) is still read and written at the dependent; two packages with no base relation at a member both hold still 409 naming both, and at a member one of them holds that package's row is read and written; a base that ships the name in code answers as today (bare read 404, bare save writes the dependent's customization row), pinned unchanged.

Unchanged and green: `meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts` (M1, M2, S2 untouched) and `meta-bare-write-doors-follow-base-34681.test.ts`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 178 passed (178)` at 80f540b6.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per moved pin; mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, rebuild, dist preflight, restore to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- A, the publish-mode save's one-holder arm blanked (`const resolved = base ?? address.packageId` read as `address.packageId`): marker present in dist; tests 1, 2 and 5 red (`Tests 3 failed | 3 passed (6)`); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- B, `packagelessRowHeldBaseDraftAddress` returning the stored address: tests 3 and 4 red (`Tests 2 failed | 4 passed (6)`), re-run on 80f540b6 with the same reading; restored, blob == HEAD.
- C, the draft save's follow condition back to ambiguous-only: test 3 red, the draft save writing `package=com.qa.authoredaddon` (`Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`); restored, blob == HEAD.
- Restore leg: rebuilt, all three markers absent from the 24 built files, pins `Tests 6 passed (6)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Not moved, same family (reported to the seat, not built here): at this cell the bare delete still removes WD's row, and the bare history, diff and rollback still read and restore WD's versions, while the bare read answers 404 (measured in process on main and on this head). They ask the row-held base only with two or more holders. Whether they follow the base (where there is nothing of the base's to remove or restore) is a design question for that family, not this card.
- Not moved: a base that ships the name in code, with a dependent's stored row at another member: the bare read at that member answers 404 and the bare save writes the dependent's customization row (measured, pinned unchanged).
- `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`'s sentence "an `active` save then writes the row of the one package the item's active rows are bound to" now has this cell as an exception at the member grain, and `rowHeldBaseAddressOf`'s docblock says the writes ask it only with two or more holders. Both are text for sibling card #35529, which rewrites those descriptions; untouched here.
- On main, the history naming WA at fr-FR (where WA holds no row) answered `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`; observation only.
